name: WhitelistDb Mod
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.

description: This mod adds support for using a database as a whitelist, making it easier for players to whitelist on a Minecraft server and saving admins time from manually running the default command to whitelist everyone.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-21 (3f1dc50b) (34 classes, 38 members). Not run yet.
